verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلذَّٰرِيَـٰتِ ذَرْوًا
verses.translation: By the winds which scatter dust,

verses.arabic: فَٱلْحَـٰمِلَـٰتِ وِقْرًا
verses.translation: which carry clouds laden with water,

verses.arabic: فَٱلْجَـٰرِيَـٰتِ يُسْرًا
verses.translation: which then smoothly speed along,

verses.arabic: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَـٰتِ أَمْرًا
verses.translation: and execute the great task of apportioning (rainfall):

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ
verses.translation: surely what you are being warned against is true,

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
verses.translation: and the Judgement shall doubtlessly take place.

verses.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
verses.translation: By the heaven with its numerous forms:

verses.arabic: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ
verses.translation: surely you are at variance (about the Hereafter);

verses.arabic: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
verses.translation: though only those who are averse to the Truth will turn away from (believing in it).

verses.arabic: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
verses.translation: Doomed are the conjecturers

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ
verses.translation: who are steeped in ignorance and heedlessness.

verses.arabic: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.translation: They ask: “When will the Day of Judgement be?”

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
verses.translation: It will be the Day when they shall be scourged by the Fire

verses.arabic: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
verses.translation: (and be told): “Taste your ordeal! This is what you were seeking to hasten.”

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.translation: As for the God-fearing, they shall be in the midst of gardens and fountains,

verses.arabic: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
verses.translation: joyously receiving what their Lord will have granted them. Verily they did good works before (the coming of this Day):

verses.arabic: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
verses.translation: they used to sleep but little by night,

verses.arabic: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
verses.translation: and would ask for forgiveness at dawn,

verses.arabic: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
verses.translation: and in their wealth there was a rightful share for him who would ask and for the destitute.

verses.arabic: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
verses.translation: There are many Signs on earth for those of sure faith,

verses.arabic: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.translation: and also in your own selves. Do you not see?

verses.arabic: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
verses.translation: And in heaven is your provision and also what you are being promised.

verses.arabic: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
verses.translation: So, by the Lord of the heaven and the earth, this is certainly true, as true as the fact of your speaking.

verses.arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
verses.translation: (O Prophet), did the story of Abraham's honoured guests reach you?

verses.arabic: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
verses.translation: When they came to him, they said: “Peace”; he said: “Peace also be to you; (you seem to be) a group of strangers.”

verses.arabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ
verses.translation: Then he went back to his family and brought a fat roasted calf

verses.arabic: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.translation: and laid it before them, saying: “Will you not eat?”

verses.arabic: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
verses.translation: Then he became afraid of them. They said: “Fear not,” and announced to him the good news of (the birth of) a boy endowed with knowledge.

verses.arabic: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ
verses.translation: So hearing his wife went forth shouting. She struck her face and exclaimed: “A barren old woman am I.”

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.translation: They said: “So has your Lord said (that you shall have a boy). Surely He is Most Wise, All-Knowing.”

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.translation: Abraham said: “Envoys (of Allah), what is your errand?”

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
verses.translation: They replied: “Behold, we have been sent to a wicked people

verses.arabic: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ
verses.translation: that we may unleash a shower of clay-stones

verses.arabic: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.translation: marked by your Lord upon those who go beyond the limits.”

verses.arabic: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translation: Then We evacuated there from all the believers

verses.arabic: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.translation: – and We did not find there any, apart from a single house of Muslims –

verses.arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
verses.translation: and We left therein a Sign for those who fear the grievous chastisement.

verses.arabic: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.translation: There is also a Sign for you in the story of Moses when We sent him with a clear authority to Pharaoh.

verses.arabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَـٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
verses.translation: But Pharaoh turned away, showing arrogance on account of his power, and said (about Moses): “He is either a sorcerer or a madman.”

verses.arabic: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
verses.translation: So We seized him and his hosts, and cast them into the sea. He became an object of much blame.

verses.arabic: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
verses.translation: There is also a Sign for you in (the story of) Ad, when We let loose upon them an ominous wind

verses.arabic: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
verses.translation: that left nothing that it came upon without reducing it to rubble.

verses.arabic: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verses.translation: There is also a Sign for you in (the story of) Thamud. They were told: “Enjoy yourselves for a while.”

verses.arabic: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.translation: But they brazenly disobeyed their Lord's command, and then a sudden chastisement overtook them while they looked on.

verses.arabic: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ
verses.translation: They were unable even to stand up or protect themselves.

verses.arabic: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ
verses.translation: Before all these We destroyed the people of Noah: they were a wicked people.

verses.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
verses.translation: And heaven – We made it with Our Own Power and We have the Power to do so.

verses.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَـٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَـٰهِدُونَ
verses.translation: And the earth – We spread it out, and how well have We smoothed it!

verses.arabic: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.translation: And of everything We have created pairs; perhaps you will take heed.

verses.arabic: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.translation: Flee, therefore, to Allah. Surely I am a clear warner to you from Him;

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.translation: and do not set up any deity with Allah. Surely I am a clear warner to you from Him.

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
verses.translation: Thus has it been (in the past): never did a Messenger come to the nations that preceded them but they said: “(He is) a sorcerer, or a mad-man.”

verses.arabic: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
verses.translation: Have they arrived at a common understanding concerning this? No; but they are a people given to transgression.

verses.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍ
verses.translation: So turn your attention away from them; you shall incur no blame.

verses.arabic: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translation: Do, however, keep exhorting them; for exhortation benefits those endowed with faith.

verses.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
verses.translation: I created the jinn and humans for nothing else but that they may serve Me;

verses.arabic: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ
verses.translation: I desire from them no provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
verses.translation: Surely Allah is the Bestower of all provision, the Lord of all power, the Strong.

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَـٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
verses.translation: The wrong-doers shall receive a portion of the chastisements as their fellows (of yore). So let them not rush Me.

verses.arabic: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
verses.translation: Woe, then, betide those who disbelieved in that Day of theirs which they are being asked to hold in dread.
